cpmplus.w4rig.menu.bone: Make a bone of this piece
cpmplus.w4rig.blockanim.menu.desc: In Animate mode, clicking a block that shares its group with others makes a bone just for it (pivot where it touches the rest) and selects it, ready to animate. Nothing moves; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.w4rig.blockanim.on: Animate block by block: ON. In Animate mode, click a block and it gets its own bone right away.
cpmplus.w4rig.blockanim.off: Animate block by block: off (clicking selects the whole group).
cpmplus.w4rig.blockanim.made: Bone '%s' made for this block (Ctrl+Z undoes it)
cpmplus.w4rig.blockanim.refused: Could not make a bone for '%s': %s
cpmplus.w4rig.groupsonly.menu.desc: In Animate mode the outliner shows only the groups (bones) and hides the blocks. Edit mode shows everything.
cpmplus.w4rig.groupsonly.on: Groups-only list: ON (applies in Animate mode).
cpmplus.w4rig.part.head: head
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.msg: The %s ('%s') turns around a point in the MIDDLE of it. In game it will come off the body when you walk.
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.msg.strong: The %s ('%s') turns around a point far away from it (almost certainly a mistake). In game it will come off the body when you walk.
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.msg.dva: (This part has 'no Minecraft animation': only your own animations are affected.)
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.tooltip: The joint is decided by the pivot of the FOLDER (group), not of the cube. Changing the cube pivot does not fix this.
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.consequence: Fix: 'Move pivot to the joint' changes only the folder pivot; the cubes stay where they are.
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.rotated: '%s' is rotated: set the folder rotation to 0 first (moving the pivot of a rotated folder would move the cubes).
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.keyed.title: Animations will look different
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.keyed.text: These animations turn or scale this part around the old point and will look different: %s
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.done.fix: pivot moved to the joint on %s part(s)
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.undo.fix: CPM+: move pivot to the joint
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.undo.unignore: CPM+: warn about the joint again
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.panel.title: Check joints
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.panel.intro: Each body part turns in game around the pivot of its root folder. Here you see whether that point is at the joint (shoulder, hip, neck, waist).
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.panel.noCubes: %s: no visible cubes, nothing to check
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.panel.ignored: %s: warning ignored (tick 'Show ignored' to see it)
cpmplus.w4rig.g18.panel.warnStrong: WARNING (almost certainly a mistake) - %s turns at %s; suggested joint: %s
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.title: Build chain
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.titleSingle: Make a bone of this piece
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.intro: Each piece becomes a bone that turns at the seam with the previous one. Nothing moves.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.introSingle: The piece gets its own folder with the pivot where it touches its parent. Nothing moves.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.joint.center: At the centre of the piece
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.mode.chain: Chain (each piece inside the previous one)
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.mode.separate: Separate bones (side by side, for fringes and tufts)
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.preview.intro: Pieces in order and the joint of each one (x, y, z). You can type other values.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.fork: The order could not be decided here (two pieces are almost equally close). Go back and use 'Order I clicked' or 'Outliner order'. Nothing was changed.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.gapRow: '%s' does not touch the previous piece: the joint is in the middle of the gap
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.budget: New folders: %s (each one is a part in game).
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.forkBlocked: The order is unclear (orange rows). Choose 'Order I clicked' or 'Outliner order' first.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.done: %s bones; each piece now turns at the seam with the previous one
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.failed: The chain was not built and nothing changed: %s
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.empty: Select the cubes (or folders) of the chain first.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.parents: Select pieces that are inside the same body part (the same folder).
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.atRoot: The pieces must be inside a body part (for example inside 'body').
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.root: '%s' is a body part; select the pieces inside it.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.keyed: '%s' has animation keyframes: building the chain would change the movement. Build the chain before animating.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.slot: '%s' is an item slot and cannot be a link.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.reserved: '%s' is a reserved name (body part names would become body parts). Choose another prefix.
cpmplus.w4rig.g19.err.nameUsed: These names already exist: %s. Choose another prefix.
